assumptions: FY2027 (53 weeks) GAAP diluted-EPS scenarios, split-adjusted price basis. Starting anchor: reported FY27 first-half GAAP diluted EPS of $4.85. Q3 revenue outlook is $108bn ±2%, 74% GAAP gross-margin midpoint and about $9.2bn GAAP opex; it gives no EPS outlook. Assumptions therefore use a constant diluted-share approximation: bear $9.50 assumes Q3 revenue/margin conversion and the 14-week Q4 soften materially versus the implied run-rate (including demand or supply/policy disruption); base $10.50 assumes Q3 guidance is broadly delivered and Q4 sustains demand with the 14-week quarter; bull $11.50 assumes higher Q3/Q4 conversion from AI-platform demand. P/E inputs (17x/22x/27x) are hypothetical stress assumptions, not observed multiples, consensus, normal/fair values or probabilities.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
